get.description: Read a page of contracts. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of contracts that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a contract with the given properties and return a copy of the object, including the ID. Documentation and examples for creating standard contracts is provided.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.summary: Archive a batch of contracts by ID
post.description: Archive a batch of contracts by their IDs. This operation moves the specified contracts to the archive, making them inactive but still retrievable if needed.

Create multiple contracts in a single request by providing the necessary properties and associations for each contract. This endpoint returns a batch response containing the details of each created contract.

post.summary: Read a batch of contracts by internal ID, or unique property values
post.description: Retrieve records by record ID or include the `idProperty` parameter to retrieve records by a custom unique value property.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.summary: Update a batch of contracts by internal ID, or unique property values
post.description: Update multiple contracts by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint allows you to modify the properties of several contracts in a single request, streamlining the update process for batch operations.

post.summary: Create or update a batch of contracts by unique property values
post.description: Create or update records identified by a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object.

Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to specify the contact by an optional 'idProperty' set to 'email'. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist, preventing future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the specified objects into a single object. It is useful for consolidating duplicate records and maintaining a clean and organized database.

post.summary: Search for contracts using specified criteria.
post.description: Execute a search query to find contracts based on defined filters, properties, and sorting options. This allows for retrieving specific contract records that match the search criteria.
